reviews.title: Perfect for Local LLMs - 5060 Ti vs 3060 for AI Work
reviews.comment:
Got this PNY RTX 5060 Ti specifically to run local LLMs on my ThinkStation P520, and it's been exactly what I needed. At $491 for the renewed unit, it's a steal compared to overpriced RTX 3060s.
My Setup:
- Lenovo P520 with 64GB RAM
- Dual GPU: Existing GTX 1660 (6GB) + new RTX 5060 Ti (16GB)
- OLLAMA running in WSL2 on Windows 11
- Total VRAM: 22GB across both cards
Real-World Experience:
Since I already had the 1660 installed, driver setup was already done - literally plug-and-play. The only hiccup was the power connector location: it's at the far end of the card, opposite from the PSU, so I had to buy an 8-pin extension cable. Minor inconvenience, worth mentioning.
Performance for AI:
- 16GB GDDR7 is a massive upgrade over the 3060's 12GB of slower memory
- Local LLMs load and run smoothly
- Heavy-duty build quality, runs efficiently under sustained AI workloads
- Dual-fan cooling keeps temps in check during long training sessions
Why 5060 Ti over 3060?
I looked at RTX 3060s but they're overpriced for 12GB of slower VRAM. Also tried an AMD RX 9060 with 16GB - OLLAMA wouldn't even use it because Linux driver support is lacking. If you're comparing 3060 vs 5060 for LLMs, the 5060 is the clear winner: faster memory, more capacity, better long-term value.
Bottom Line:
Verified purchase, expert/professional user running daily AI workloads. Packaging was good, card arrived in excellent condition. For local LLM work, this is the sweet spot. Skip the 3060, grab this 5060 Ti.
